Locations
List of wolves that may be found in the following places:

Briarwood: The wolves are found in several encounters. Vine wolves can also be related to this category of creature.

Snowhill: Mostly called 'frostfang', these wolves have a snowy white coat, and can be encountered in the Frostfang Caverns, and lone instances.

Wilds: Other wolves can be found in dungeons, roaming the wilds, and sometimes as pets.

Shrouded Gloam: Corrupted wolves are found in Shrouded Glade during the Gloam Invasion.
